260:t_000:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「You don't seem to grasp how vast space is...」

260:t_000:11.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$ワッ太$$... Do you know how many light-years it is from Earth to Pluto?」

260:t_000:13.en:
$$隼人$$
「It's about 40 astronomical units... That's less than 0.001 light-years.」

260:t_000:15.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then even that last jump took us way beyond the solar system!」

260:t_000:17.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Now, now... This jump was only a test. With the right conditions, we can jump much farther.」

260:t_000:18.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「That's correct. My calculations show I can navigate about 100 light-years, without obstacles such as dimensional faults.」

260:t_000:19.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「That's over 100 times farther than this jump.」

260:t_000:20.en:
$$木下$$
「A hundred light-years is 10,000 times the distance between Earth and Pluto!」

260:t_000:22.en:
$$勝平$$
「All right! Now I can see some hope!」

260:t_000:23.en:
$$柿小路$$
「The problem... will be the cost.」

260:t_000:24.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$號$$... How long will it take to store enough energy to open a wormhole?」

260:t_000:25.en:
$$號$$
「It will take a week to ten days.」

260:t_000:26.en:
$$恵子$$
「Even if we jump 100 light-years at a time, if each jump takes that many days...!」

260:t_000:27.en:
$$厚井$$
「This really looks like a journey that'll take decades...」

260:t_000:28.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...Oh dear... This is rather unfortunate...」

260:t_000:30.en:
$$田中司令$$
「When it rains, it pours... We seem to have some uninvited guests.」

260:t_002:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So those are the parallel world's $$宇宙怪獣$$...!」

260:t_002:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「They're completely different from the ones in our world.」

260:t_002:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(I never expected to encounter them here... I can't simply be happy about this.)

260:t_002:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...So I was right after all...」

260:t_002:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ tend to follow the $$バニシングドライブ波$$ produced during a warp.」

260:t_002:6.en:
$n
「Then whenever we make a hyperspace jump, they'll show up...!」

260:t_002:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...I thought the $$宇宙怪獣$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$ were just survivors who'd been transported here, like me...」

260:t_002:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But if there are this many at the galactic center, they must have a nest here...!」

260:t_002:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They have a $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest...!?」

260:t_002:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「In my world, the $$宇宙怪獣$$ made their nest at the galactic center.」

260:t_002:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And it gives birth to practically endless numbers of $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

260:t_002:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「They have a nest in this world, too...」

260:t_002:13.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s data also leads to that conclusion.」

260:t_002:14.en:
$$葵$$
「So the galactic center held the biggest $$バアル$$ threat of all.」

260:t_002:15.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's a surprise. They exist across multiple parallel worlds?」

260:t_002:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We can research them later! Those monsters are already itching for a fight!」

260:t_002:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it! Are we gonna keep playing tag with these things till we get home!?」

260:t_002:18.en:
$$青山$$
「Just thinking of that going on for ten years gives me chills...!」

260:t_002:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「Who can think ten years ahead!? Let's get through right now first!」

260:t_002:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, begin your attack. Unless we wipe them out here, they'll pursue us endlessly.」

260:t_002:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Don't just stand there, $$ノノ$$! $$宇宙怪獣$$ are still $$宇宙怪獣$$, even in a parallel world!」

260:t_003:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「They just keep swarming and swarming...! Fighting these things really gets to you!」

260:t_003:1.en:
$$さやか$$
「I can see why they're called humanity's natural enemy!」

260:t_003:5.en:
$$凱$$
「More $$宇宙怪獣$$!? Give me a break!」

260:t_004:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「The humans who slew our great god, Lord $$ハーデス$$...!」

260:t_004:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「I never thought you would come to this sea of stars!」

260:t_004:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「What are those things!? Giants!? Robots!?」

260:t_004:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「They call themselves gods of $$オリュンポス$$. We call them $$ミケーネ$$ gods, since they existed in the civilization left in $$ミケーネ$$ on Earth.」

260:t_004:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Gods...!? Do you mean actual gods!?」

260:t_004:8.en:
$$弁慶$$
「But their power does indeed far exceed human understanding.」

260:t_004:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「They also came to Earth in the age of myths to obtain $$次元力|lc$$, but...」

260:t_004:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$, a just god of $$オリュンポス$$, defeated them and sealed them in $$ミケーネ$$.」

260:t_004:11.en:
$$隼人$$
「We fought them after they were freed from their seal. We defeated their king, $$ハーデス$$, ruler of the underworld, and crushed his ambitions.」

260:t_004:12.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That anger and hatred still burn in our hearts!」

260:t_004:13.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We came to destroy the embodiment of endless destruction we heard had appeared. I never expected to find you...!」

260:t_004:14.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「This is a perfect chance...! We shall bury you here along with that $$バアル$$!」

260:t_004:15.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「This is lucky. If those giants fight the $$宇宙怪獣$$, that'll be a huge help to us.」

260:t_004:16.en:
$$シモン$$
「We can't celebrate yet, $$ニコラ$$. They're after us, too.」

260:t_004:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「We could get caught between the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$ミケーネ$$!」

260:t_004:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「And their power lives up to the name of gods...! They're on a whole different level from our previous enemies!」

260:t_004:19.en:
$n
「Damn it...! We've hit trouble on our very first jump...!」

260:t_005:0.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「How feeble you humans are!」

260:t_005:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「So your victory over Lord $$ハーデス$$ was some kind of mistake after all!」

260:t_005:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now weep and beg for your lives! Cling to the gods' mercy!」

260:t_005:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「Gods, my ass...! You think you're so great just because you're a little stronger than humans!」

260:t_005:4.en:
$$青山$$
「But it's true we're in trouble if this keeps up.」
